name: Rebase Hermes fork
description: Weekly: rebase the local hermes-agent vision leftover onto NousResearch/hermes-agent main. Drop the fork if upstream absorbed the last deltas.
title: Rebase Hermes fork onto upstream main
notes:
Repo: ~/.hermes/hermes-agent. PR: NousResearch/hermes-agent#86426 (branch fix/local-ollama-native-images, fork acollier88/hermes-agent-1). Backup: ollama-vision-routing-pre-2026-08-14.

1. git fetch upstream
2. Check whether these leftover deltas are now on upstream/main (or the PR merged):
   - suppress vision_analyze when the turn already has a native image_url
   - media in tool results for custom / ollama / ollama-launch
   - _resolve_custom_runtime tries the default named custom provider first
3. If all three landed, stop using the fork: checkout upstream/main (or the latest tag), reinstall the venv hermes, and complete this series (clear recurrence).
4. If not: rebase the leftover onto upstream/main (one unique commit), resolve tests, leave the running binary as ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/hermes.
5. Do not force-push origin unless asked. Never print tokens.

When finished: apple-tasks update <id> --append-notes "<what you did>" then complete so next Friday rolls forward.
